en.headline: URA receives three tenders for final To Kwa Wan redevelopment plot
en.dek: CK Asset, China Overseas Land & Investment and a Sino Land-Great Eagle consortium submitted bids for the To Kwa Wan Road/Wing Kwong Street project after the noon deadline.
body: The Urban Renewal Authority said it received three tenders for its To Kwa Wan Road/Wing Kwong Street development scheme when submissions closed at noon on Wednesday.

The bidders were CK Asset, China Overseas Land & Investment, and a consortium formed by Sino Land and Great Eagle. The site is the last of eight contiguous projects under the authority’s district-based redevelopment scheme in To Kwa Wan.

The project covers about 58,900 square feet and can provide roughly 900 flats, or about 1,050 if modular integrated construction is used. Market valuations before the tender ranged from about HK$3.45 billion to HK$4.6 billion.

A selection panel set up by the URA board will assess the submissions and make a recommendation, with the final decision resting with the board. Earlier tenders in the same area had drawn more interest.
Correction: an earlier version contained typographical errors in the Chinese text which have been fixed.

zh.headline: 市建局土瓜灣道／榮光街項目截收三份標書
zh.dek: 長實、中海外及信和與鷹君合組財團在周三中午截標時入標，該項目為土瓜灣小區重建最後一個地盤。
body: 市區重建局表示，土瓜灣道／榮光街發展計劃周三中午十二時截標，共接獲三份標書。
入標者包括長實集團、中國海外發展，以及信和置業與鷹君集團合組的財團。該地盤是市建局在土瓜灣以小區模式推行的八個重建項目中的最後一個。
項目地盤面積約五萬八千九百平方呎，預計可提供約九百個住宅單位；若採用組裝合成建築法，單位數目可增至約一千零五十伙。市場早前估值介乎約三十四億五千萬至四十六億元。
市建局董事會設立的選選小組將評估標書並向董事會提交建議，最終由董事會決定。區內早前多個招標均錄得較多入標。
更正：較早版本中文文本有錯字，現已修正。
